integrity: All infinite-dimensional conclusions are proved from the spectral theorem and exact measure arguments. No finite numerical experiment is used as evidence for the theorem.
limitations: The characterization is proved only for bounded normal operators on complex Hilbert spaces.

The operator-stability ingredients are classical spectral-theorem facts; the new claim is their exact synthesis for asymptotic and strong asymptotic expansivity together with the normal same-spectrum separation.
An equivalent formulation may exist under older stability terminology not surfaced by the checked searches.
title: Boundary spectral projection criterion for asymptotic expansivity of normal operators
